paper_title: AgentWorld: Benchmarking Long-Horizon Collaboration of Multi-agent LLMs
reason: AgentWorld는 재사용 가능한 영어 텍스트 기반 멀티에이전트 협업 벤치마크로 보이며, 시스템 프롬프트가 영어("You are an intelligent AI agent that plays the AgentWorld MMORPG game")이고 관찰도 구조화된 텍스트이므로 en 트랙의 text 모달리티 후보입니다. 하지만 논문 PDF에는 공식 데이터셋이나 코드의 URL이 적혀 있지 않습니다. 각주 1은 'Code and data on GitHub'라고만 쓰고 주소를 밝히지 않으며, 프로젝트 웹사이트(agentworld.io)는 데이터셋이나 코드 저장소 주소가 아닙니다. 명시된 GitHub 주소(Kaetram-Open)는 기반이 되는 제3자 게임 엔진이라 공식 링크로 쓸 수 없습니다. 공식 리소스 링크를 PDF에서 확인할 수 없으므로 링크 근거가 확보될 때까지 제안을 보류합니다.

screening.paper_title: AgentWorld: Benchmarking Long-Horizon Collaboration of Multi-agent LLMs
screening.abstract: Existing multi-agent benchmarks primarily test in competitive settings, short-horizon interactions under 20 steps, or simply aggregate individual performance, failing to isolate and highlight genuine collaboration capabilities of LLM-based agents. We introduce AgentWorld, a benchmark of 100 human-annotated tasks (with 100 augmented variants) for evaluating long-horizon, multi-agent collaboration. Tasks span 50+ interaction rounds across a rich MMORPG sandbox and require 3-20 agents with asymmetric roles and abilities to coordinate through communication, joint planning, and resource sharing under a blackbox setting where each agent acts independently without access to others' internal states. To quantify collaboration effectiveness in addition to conventional binary task success, we propose Causal Collaboration Effectiveness (CCE), a graph-based metric that traces causal dependencies between agent actions and measures what fraction of a team's effort actually contributed to the outcome. Experiments with Gemini 3 Flash, Claude Haiku 4.5, GPT-5 Mini, and DeepSeek R1-70B show that even the best model achieves only 52.0% task success, with systematic failure modes including communication breakdowns, role confusion, and inability to maintain shared plans across rounds. AgentWorld is fully open-source.
